# SOP-P3-L3-02 Product changeover - Machining line

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03  
Related documents: SB-1005, SB-1010, SOP-P3-L3-04

1. Preconditions
   1.1 Verify production schedule authorizes changeover for P3-L3.  
   1.2 Confirm machine status is STOPPED and locked out per SB-1005 and SB-1010.  
   1.3 All tooling for new product must be staged and cross-checked against SOP-P3-L3-04.

2. PPE
   2.1 Required PPE: safety glasses, cut-resistant gloves, hearing protection, steel-toe footwear.  
   2.2 Use insulated tools when working on hydraulic components of EQ-P3-L3-HP03.  

3. Preparation
   3.1 Remove old fixtures from EQ-P3-L3-SB01 and EQ-P3-L3-CN02 following manufacturer access points.  
   3.2 Inspect hydraulics on EQ-P3-L3-HP03 for leaks and secure fittings before assembly.  

4. Lubrication and fasteners
   4.1 Apply lubricant part number CFW-LUB-340.  
   4.2 Tighten main ram bolt for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) to the specified value: 1600 N·m.

5. Alignment and verification
   5.1 Install new tooling and perform alignment using referenced gauges in SOP-P3-L3-04.  
   5.2 Verify sensor and switch positions against SB-1010 checklists.

6. Functional check
   6.1 Remove lockout and perform a dry cycle at no-load to confirm correct motion and clearance.  
   6.2 If any abnormal indication occurs, return to lockout and troubleshoot per SB-1005.

7. Documentation
   7.1 Record changeover actions, torque application, lubricant batch, and any nonconformances in the line changeover log.  
   7.2 Attach completed checklist to the job packet and reference SOP-P3-L3-04 where applicable.

8. Sign-off
   8.1 Operator name and signature: ____________________  
   8.2 Supervisor name and signature: ____________________  
   8.3 Date and time of final acceptance: ____________________

References: SB-1005, SB-1010, SOP-P3-L3-04
